root_cause: A material GitHub recovery was reported to the user while Required gates were still running, leaving the user unsure whether more action was expected.

The existing no-pending-final-output rule prohibited pending terminal status but did not explicitly make Powerhouse dashboard/current-state registration and the terminal user-answer shape part of the same closure gate.
prevention: Pending CI, auto-merge, deploy, readback, documentation, skill projection and dashboard registration remain internal execution states.

The owner node retains the obligation through protected merge/promotion, production/provider readback, outcome, learning/prevention, relevant skill projection and Powerhouse dashboard/current-state registration.
The standard terminal response reports what is already live/proven and what was durably registered; it does not return an autonomous what-next list.
Only an evidenced BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY may return ownership to the user, with one smallest necessary human action.
After interruption the next capable node resumes automatically from canonical state; no user 'ga door' is required.

evidence.migration_identity_rule: Repository migration identity must match the exact production Supabase migration ledger identity before terminal closure.
